_readme: Copy to ./settings.json (auto-loaded) or point $SCREENAI_SETTINGS at it,
Delete what you do not need; every value shown is the stock default.
Keys starting with '_' are documentation and are ignored.
Empty arrays or strings mean 'leave unset'.

ocr._doc: Google gocr engine (closed-source) — read at InitOCR, restart to change

mce._doc: Screen2x main-content model — read at InitMainContentExtraction, restart to change

reader._doc: Reader-view export of the main content: none | text | markdown | html

report._doc: HTML report overlays — highlight on the image what OCR and MCE detected
